verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes that accumulated tickets increase a holder's chances of winning.
The client explicitly establishes independent Small and Big Block counters, eligibility windows, and post-draw resets; no represented prior key requires removal.
Eliminating Big Blocks necessarily leaves only the Small Block counter and removes the existing Big Block lifecycle attributes; the retained removal status is a meaningful current fact.
The client unambiguously accepts the immediately preceding proposal to restart NFTs and draws under the new contract while excluding old-contract NFTs from the active system.
